decisions.key: rule:who may change the fill setpoint
decisions.title: Two answers to who may change the fill setpoint
decisions.why: WI-210 Rev D (2023) lets operators adjust the setpoint by up to 2 g. QP-303 Rev F (2024) says operators must not change it and only the Maintenance Technician may. WI-210 was not revised after QP-303, and TR-701 trains operators on WI-210.

decisions.title: MP-502 still tells technicians to use the group lock box that SP-402 Rev D removed
decisions.why: MP-502 step 7.1 locks out the case packer with the group lock box per SP-402 Rev B. SP-402 Rev D says 'Group lock box removed' and requires one person, one lock, one key. WI-213 points to SP-402 without a revision, so only MP-502 is out of date.

decisions.title: SOP-101, SOP-104 and MP-501 have the Maintenance Technician remove locks; SP-402 says each person removes only their own
decisions.why: SP-402 step 8 lets each person remove only their own lock, and Operators can be Authorized Employees. SOP-101, SOP-104 and MP-501 assign lock removal to the Maintenance Technician alone, which cannot cover a lock an operator applied.

decisions.key: rule:who moves held product to the hold cage
decisions.title: Two different roles move held product to the hold cage
decisions.why: QP-315 step 2 makes the Team Leader responsible for moving held product to the hold cage the same shift. SOP-102 step 4 has the Operator do it at shutdown. Team Leader is not defined anywhere else.

decisions.title: Forklift speed limit: 5 mph everywhere (SP-405) versus 3 mph on the dock (WH-601)
decisions.why: SP-405 step 2 says the maximum is 5 mph everywhere inside the building, including dock doors. WH-601 step 3 says no faster than 3 mph on the dock and in the receiving lanes. A driver who reads only SP-405 would think 5 mph is allowed at the dock.

MP-501 (Shift Lead releases after maintenance), SOP-104 (Shift Lead releases for changeover) and SOP-101 (Line Lead owns the start-up) describe different events and do not contradict each other. The Shift Lead versus Line Lead naming is left for the plant to decide.

QP-315 lets anyone place product on hold, so the QA Technician (QP-303, QP-316), Line Lead (QP-303), Operator (WI-211, WI-212) are all allowed. QP-303's own roles table and step 5 name different people, but neither forbids the other.
QP-306, SOP-101 and SOP-105 all give first-off approval to the QA Technician.
QP-308 and WH-601 both give release to the QA Technician, and WI-212 only loads rolls that carry the QA release sticker.

decisions.key: rule:which suppliers packaging may be used
decisions.why: QP-309 limits purchasing to the listed supplier, QP-308 rejects lots from unlisted suppliers and WI-212 refuses rolls from unlisted suppliers. The three documents agree.

decisions.key: rule:who checks the dock before entering a trailer
decisions.why: SP-405 and WH-601 both require the Forklift Driver to chock the wheels and lock the dock leveler before entering a trailer.

Measured at different points: MP-502 reads at least 0.7 bar at the pump inlet with the erector idle, WI-213 reads at least 0.6 bar at the erector cups with a case on them. The lower figure at the cups is expected, but neither document says how the two relate.

decisions.title: Two torque values for the same 38 mm cap
decisions.why: WI-211 Rev C raised the 38 mm cap torque from 15 to 17 in-lb after leak complaints. SOP-104 step 7.3 still tells the Operator to set 15 in-lb, and TR-701 requires operators to be trained on WI-211 Rev A, the version before the change. Line 2 operators following SOP-104 or trained to TR-701 would set the old torque.

findings.title: Label liner caliper is critical on every lot (QP-309 Rev G) but QP-308 does not check it
findings.detail: QP-309 Rev G made label liner caliper (0.075 mm plus or minus 0.005) a critical characteristic that must be measured on every lot. QP-308 Rev D (2023, older than QP-309 Rev G) lists the label checks at incoming inspection and liner caliper is not among them. QP-309 step 3 also requires QP-308 to be updated after a change.

evidence.quote: Characteristics marked critical below must be measured on every lot.
Label liner caliper made a critical characteristic for the new Line 3 labeler.
print quality, barcode grade C or better, roll width, core diameter 76 mm, labels wound outward.

findings.title: SOP-104 locks out only FIL-2 and CAP-2 but the changeover also works on LAB-2, CPK-2 and CNV-2
findings.detail: SP-402 applies to all servicing, cleaning and jam clearing that puts any part of the body inside a guard on any equipment. SOP-104 locks out only FIL-2 and CAP-2 in preparation, then has operators change parts on the labeler, case packer and conveyor with no lockout stated. If those changes reach inside a guard, SP-402 requires a lock.

evidence.quote: Lock out FIL-2 and CAP-2 as described in SP-402.
change the case magazine guides and select the pack pattern
All servicing, cleaning and jam clearing that puts any part of the body inside a guard, on any equipment at Plant 2.

findings.title: SOP-102 shutdown cleaning does not refer to lockout
findings.detail: SOP-102 has operators clean the filler nozzles and drip tray and empty the case packer reject bin, and does not mention SP-402. SP-402 covers cleaning that puts any part of the body inside a guard. Whether these tasks reach inside guards is not stated.

evidence.quote: Clean filler nozzles and the drip tray. Wipe the labeler rollers. Empty the case packer reject bin.
All servicing, cleaning and jam clearing that puts any part of the body inside a guard, on any equipment at Plant 2.

findings.title: QP-306 asks for a packed case at first-off but SOP-101 start-up does not produce one
findings.detail: QP-306 step 1 has the Operator bring the first 5 good bottles and one packed case to the QA bench, and QA checks the case in step 6. SOP-101 steps 11 and 12 run 20 bottles and take the first-off samples to the QA Technician, with no step for a packed case.

evidence.quote: Bring the first 5 good bottles and one packed case to the QA bench.
Run 20 bottles and stop. Take the first-off samples to the QA Technician.

findings.title: QP-306 checks cap removal torque against a range that WI-211 does not give
findings.detail: QP-306 step 3 passes the first-off cap if removal torque is inside the range in WI-211. WI-211 only gives an application torque with a tolerance for each cap size, and has the operator measure removal torque without stating a removal range.

evidence.quote: Cap: correct cap, removal torque inside the range in WI-211.
